# sh-indicator

**Purpose:** small pill or dot on icons, tabs and avatars that signals new or unread items. Information (blue) by default; Error (red) only for errors. Count hugs its number.

**Keywords:** indicator, notification badge, count badge, unread count, dot, counter, pill

Core · 4 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2717-39751) (node `2717:39751`)

## Types

### Type=Count, Status=Information

**Purpose:** pill showing an unread or pending count, the default for notifications and updates.

### Type=Count, Status=Error

**Purpose:** pill showing an unread or pending count, only for errors or failed actions.

### Type=Dot, Status=Information

**Purpose:** dot showing something new without a number, the default for notifications and updates.

### Type=Dot, Status=Error

**Purpose:** dot showing something new without a number, only for errors or failed actions.
